name: leveling
description: Message and voice XP with 7 selectable level formulas, rank cards, leaderboards, level-up announcements, and role rewards.
short: Message and voice XP with rank cards and leaderboards.
endUserDataStatement: Stores user ID with level, XP, message counts, and voice minutes per server. Deleted on GDPR erasure.

configFields.label: Level Formula
configFields.description: Curve for XP required per level: disgaea, fibonacci, linear, mee6, atlas, arcane, or lurkr.

configFields.label: Message XP
configFields.description: XP granted per rewarded message, before multipliers.

configFields.label: Message Cooldown
configFields.description: How long a member waits between rewarded messages.

configFields.label: Minimum Message Length
configFields.description: Messages shorter than this earn no XP but still count.

configFields.label: Voice XP Enabled
configFields.description: Track voice minutes and grant XP for time in voice channels.

configFields.label: Voice XP Per Minute
configFields.description: XP granted per audible minute in voice, before multipliers.

configFields.label: Level-Up Announcements
configFields.description: Post a message when a member levels up.

configFields.label: Announcement Channel
configFields.description: Channel for level-up messages. Empty falls back to where they leveled up, then the system channel.

configFields.label: Ignored Roles
configFields.description: Members with any of these roles earn no XP.

configFields.label: Level Role Rewards
configFields.description: Roles granted when members reach levels.

configFields.label: Stack Reward Roles
configFields.description: Keep every earned reward role. Off swaps to the highest earned one.

configFields.label: Keep XP On Leave
configFields.description: Keep progress and restore reward roles on rejoin. Off wipes progress when a member leaves.

configFields.label: Global XP Multiplier
configFields.description: Multiplies all XP gains on this server.

configFields.label: Role Multipliers
configFields.description: Per-role XP multipliers as roleId:mult entries. Highest applies.

configFields.label: Channel Multipliers
configFields.description: Per-channel XP multipliers as channelId:mult entries.
